title: Bethnal Green Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical facilities and help points for Bethnal Green and surrounding areas.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 first.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- The Royal London Hospital, Whitechapel Road, London E1 1FR. Major Trauma Centre. Approximate travel: from Bethnal Green Station, ~15 minutes walk south down Cambridge Heath Road (~0.8 miles), or bus 254 or 106 south to Whitechapel.
- Homerton University Hospital, Homerton Row, London E9 6SR. Full 24-hour A&E. Approximate travel: from Cambridge Heath Station, ~25 minutes walk north via Mare Street and Homerton High Street (~1.3 miles), or bus 254/106 north to Hackney Central/Homerton.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres:
- The Royal London Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre, Ground Floor, Whitechapel Road, London E1 1FR. Walk south via Cambridge Heath Road.
- Homerton Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre, Homerton Row, London E9 6SR. Walk or take bus 254 north towards Homerton.

3. Local Hazard Notes:
- The Regent's Canal cuts along the eastern and northern boundaries of the neighbourhood. Towpaths and low-lying ground adjacent to Roman Road and Victoria Park may experience localized waterlogging. Flash downpours frequently create deep surface water pooling in railway underpasses around Cambridge Heath and Bethnal Green rail arches.

4. Essential Supplies:
- Community pharmacies and large supermarkets situated on Bethnal Green Road, Roman Road, and Cambridge Heath Road supply water, first-aid materials, and critical medicines during emergencies.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
